contract: Road user a overtakes and passes road user b from the rear: a, travelling in the same direction as b, comes from having b ahead of it to having b behind it. b is ahead of a where the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing) is positive and the two bodies' projections on a's heading share no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative); b is behind a where that component is negative and the projections share no length. The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction). The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it. Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized. It denotes the relative motion of the two road users only: it says nothing of the lanes they occupy, of whether b moves, or of why a passes. Not denoted: a drawing alongside b that does not clear b; b ahead of a only while their headings are not aligned (a road user met head-on or crossing); b behind a at every observation of the window.

params.name: window
params.meaning: the longest duration of a pass the concept recognizes: how far behind the observation it looks for b ahead of a

params.name: same_dir_cos
params.meaning: cosine of the largest heading difference at which a and b count as travelling in the same direction

act.onset: The act begins at the last observation of the window behind at which b was ahead of a with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction).
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which b is behind a and was not behind a at the previous observation, where b was ahead of a with headings aligned at some observation of the window behind.
act.extent: The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until b has again been ahead of a and then comes to be behind it.
act.history: Conduct before the window behind is not read: a pass that takes longer than the window is not recognized.

elements.span: the longitudinal component of b's bearing in a's frame (rel.bearing)
elements.justification: rel.bearing: 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for "on the right of", "immediately to the rear")'; its longitudinal component's sign tells b ahead of a from b behind it.

elements.span: the two bodies' projections on a's heading share no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap negative)
elements.justification: rel.longitudinal_overlap: 'the length the two footprints' projections on that axis share, negative for the gap between the projections'; a negative value means the bodies are not side by side, so a has cleared b (or not yet reached it). Used as a projection, not as a contact or a distance.

elements.span: with their headings aligned within same_dir_cos (rel.same_direction)
elements.justification: rel.same_direction: 'headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance', with the tolerance same_dir_cos; it tells an overtaking from a meeting or a crossing.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: a follows b in the same lane 15 m behind at 12 m/s while b is halted; a moves to the adjacent lane, draws alongside and, 4 s after b was last ahead of it, has b 3 m behind it: at that observation the concept holds.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: a follows b, moves to the adjacent lane and draws alongside b, then halts with the two bodies still side by side; b never comes to be behind a within the window.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: a draws past b in the adjacent lane, but the bearing of b from a is not observed.
